checks: run.py requires every response's model field to equal the versioned model id asked for
price: $0.042 per million input tokens, output free; 3,758,840 input tokens per pass of 9,955 requests
observed: probabilities come in steps of 0.01 and sum to 1; identical requests give answers that differ by up to 0.11 (1.14) and 0.19 (1.13) in one probability
